$comment: Single source of app configuration. Values marked BLOCKED come from the owner (docs/OWNER_SETUP.md). Build tooling refuses release builds while any BLOCKED value remains.

displayName.notes: owner decision 0.1: the owner named the app Jolt (16 October 2026); the App Store listing name may need a longer form if 'Jolt' is taken there

domain.notes: owner decision 33 (docs/OWNER_DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-17): the invite page's Fly.io address until the owner buys a domain. One change moves every build to another: the repository variable APP_DOMAIN (the release workflows put it here and into the iOS build, tools/release/app_identity.py), or this value together with ios/Config/Base.xcconfig APP_DOMAIN (docs/OWNER_SETUP.md §4)

premium.notes: Owner decision 7 (docs/OWNER_DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-16): $3.99 a month, $35.99 a year, with a 1-week free trial on the yearly plan (App Store introductory offer / Play free-trial offer on premium_yearly — docs/OWNER_SETUP.md §1.6, §2.3). Display prices and the trial always come from the store at runtime.
